issues.title: As above, So below II: a subsystem shut itself down after an error
issues.explanation: The mod wraps each of its systems - rendering, transit, level generation, combat and so on - in its own kill switch. When one throws an error it is logged once, that single system is turned off, and the rest of the mod plus vanilla keep running. The log line names the system and what it was doing. This is containment by design, not a crash.
issues.fix: Open the mod settings, Diagnostics tab, to see every subsystem's health, what tripped it, and a re-arm button. Re-arming gives it another chance; if the fault is still there it trips again with a fresh log line. Please report the logged error so the underlying cause can be fixed.

issues.title: Colony started inside a small carved pocket surrounded by rock
issues.explanation: On fully mountainous tiles the surface level can generate as solid rock end to end (the mod slices its levels from a taller generated map, and a mountain can cover the whole slice). When that happens the mod carves a starting clearing so the colony is playable - an intentional mountain-base start, not a failed generation.
issues.fix: Mine outward as you would in any mountain base. Until a route to the map edge is open, walk-in raids and caravans behave like they do on any enclosed mountain map. Prefer flatter tiles if you want an open start.

issues.title: Coastline or river looks wrong / partly missing
issues.explanation: Map-edge features such as coastlines are generated against the full tall map and can land in a level that gets replaced during banding. Continuous terrain (elevation, soil, rock) slices correctly; edge-anchored water may not.
issues.fix: Choose inland tiles for now. A full fix (generating the surface at normal fidelity and transplanting it) is planned.

issues.title: Combat Extended: cross-level shooting is new and lightly tested
issues.explanation: The CE bridge maps CE's own ballistics onto stacked levels: projectiles fly and collide on the correct level, high ground affects accuracy in both directions, and suppression carries across levels. It is shape-checked against the current CE build but has not accumulated real play hours yet. If CE updates its internals, the bridge degrades one seam at a time rather than breaking, and the in-game combat report names any seam that failed to bind.
issues.fix: Treat CE colonies as experimental for now. Reports with the weapon, the levels involved and what the projectile did are exactly what gets this verified faster.

issues.title: Pawns will not mine rock on a level they are not standing on
issues.explanation: A mining target is solid rock, and solid cells are not walkable ground, so the mod's level router has nothing to aim at and does not route the pawn through the stairs. The game still reports the rock as reachable, so the pawn accepts the job and then finds no walkable route to it, and stands still or moves on to other work. The same applies to deconstructing, repairing or smoothing something set into rock on another level.
issues.fix: Send the pawn to that level first, by right clicking the stairs or by drafting it down, then give the mining order while it is on the same level. Mining works normally from there. A proper fix is in progress.

issues.title: Stairs / ladder placement is refused with a message about open cells
issues.explanation: Links require at least one open cardinal (non-diagonal) neighbouring cell, because a link reachable only diagonally jams pawns - RimWorld blocks diagonal movement past obstacles. The placement preview outlines the cells pawns can enter from.
issues.fix: Leave one orthogonally adjacent cell clear, or mark adjacent rock for mining first - cells designated for mining count as future open ground.

issues.title: Pawns cannot walk on top of walls seen from above
issues.explanation: The top of an unroofed wall is buildable (stack another wall to raise a structure) but deliberately not walkable - it is a ledge, not a floor. Roofed rooms are different: a constructed roof is a walkable rooftop across its whole footprint, walls included.
issues.fix: Working as designed. Roof the structure if you want to walk on it.

issues.title: Map generation takes noticeably longer than vanilla
issues.explanation: A banded colony generates three levels of content plus the band structure. Generation has been heavily optimized and typically takes a few seconds longer than a vanilla map of similar size.
issues.fix: Expected. If generation takes more than ~30 seconds something else is wrong - please report with your map size and tile type.

issues.title: Added the mod to an existing save and nothing changed
issues.explanation: Levels are created during map generation, so only maps generated with the mod active are banded. Existing maps stay vanilla and are fully playable.
issues.fix: Start a new colony to get levels. Removing the mod is cleanest on maps that were never banded.

issues.title: How do I remove or shrink the platform a stair or ladder created up top?
issues.explanation: A sky landing is a real constructed roof laid on the level below the platform; the walkable rooftop above is derived from it. Remove the roof below and the platform above dissolves. The small core around the stairwell itself (the stairs plus one ring) is protected so arriving pawns always have somewhere to stand, and ground is never dissolved under a standing pawn or building. Colonies from older versions are converted automatically on load.
issues.fix: On the level BELOW the platform, use vanilla's Remove roof area over the parts you do not want, and construction pawns will take it from there. Deconstructing the stairs releases the protected core too; the leftover roof below is then an ordinary roof you can keep or remove.

issues.title: Columns and floor space on the level above
issues.explanation: A column (or any roof-holding structure) below gives a buildable ledge directly above it, like a wall top. WALKABLE floor above comes from roofs, exactly as walls work: roof the area around the column on the level below and the rooftop appears above as floor you can walk and build on.
issues.fix: Build columns below, then draw vanilla's Build roof area around them (columns hold roof up to the normal 6-cell reach). The roofed area becomes rooftop floor on the level above. Remove roof area takes it away again.

issues.title: Cannot remove the rock ceiling in the basement
issues.explanation: Basement levels sit under overhead mountain - the rock ceiling IS the level above's ground - and vanilla does not allow removing thick rock roof. That is by design: a dug-out basement behaves exactly like a mined-out mountain base, infestation risk included.
issues.fix: Working as designed. Insect-proofing and lighting strategies from mountain bases apply unchanged. An openable shaft or skylight is a possible future feature, not a current one.

issues.title: Leaving the map / Walk The World prompts only on the surface level
issues.explanation: On a stacked colony the edge of the world is the SURFACE level's own perimeter, all four sides - including the sides that border the seam between levels. The outer edges of basements and sky levels are deliberately not world exits: walking to an underground map edge is not standing at the edge of the world. Mods that use the exit grid (such as Walk The World) follow this automatically; their green edge highlight may not paint the seam-side rows, but walking a pawn there still triggers the prompt.
issues.fix: Send pawns to any edge of the SURFACE level to leave the map or trigger travel prompts. To depart from another level, take the stairs to the surface first.

issues.title: Basement is always plain rock - no caverns
issues.explanation: Living cavern basements require the Biomes! Caverns mod (and its Biomes! Core framework). Without it the basement is always solid mineable rock, and the cavern settings are hidden.
issues.fix: Install Biomes! Caverns and start a new colony, then pick a cavern type (or Random) in the mod settings before generating.
